state.seed_assertion: A periodic task should include a WALLCLOCKTIME GSV in only one user task, or wrap it in a UID/UIE pair if another task also reads it.

sentences.1: A periodic task should include a WALLCLOCKTIME GSV in only one user task, or wrap it in a UID/UIE pair if another task also reads it.
sentences.2: The manual has a note on that GSV that is easy to walk past: include the WALLCLOCKTIME GSV in only one user task, or wrap it in a UID/UIE pair if another task also reads it.
sentences.3: a 10 ms periodic task writing eight tags into a 600-element ring, a trigger on the fault bit, 200 more samples, then a latch that stops the writer until somebody has read the result.
sentences.4: A periodic task writing to a ring buffer can be used to capture intermittent PLC faults, requiring approximately four rungs and 7 KB of memory.
sentences.5: A periodic task for sampling provides more reliable timestamps than a rung in the continuous task because the rung samples whenever the scan occurs, causing timestamp drift.
sentences.6: A controller major fault may leave a fault code and task information.
sentences.7: On the other hand, hardware faults tend to be affected by the end environment, which can include cables and other site-specific conditions.
sentences.8: What occurs, and when? Is there usually another activity that precedes the fault?
sentences.9: Aliasing, often a hardware issue, can be another difficult item to examine.
sentences.10: A key clue is seeing a waveform from one system in another system or data at a different time scale.
sentences.11: If one technician writes "PM," another writes "preventive," and a third writes "routine check," your spreadsheet treats them like different events unless someone cleans it up later.
sentences.12: An effective maintenance log must include identification details, job specifics, condition assessments, parts information, technician identification, and follow-up actions.
